page_title: NAP 1-0 VEN | Napoli v Venezia 29/12/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jay Idzes (Venezia) was quite harsh and Francesco Cosso didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+4' Venezia couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Alex Meret (Napoli) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Total attempts – 22:4.
88' Here is a change. Gaetano Oristanio is going off and Eusebio Di Francesco gives the last tactical orders to Saad El Haddad (Venezia).
88' Eusebio Di Francesco prepares a substitution. Francesco Zampano is replaced by Bjarki Bjarkason (Venezia).
88' Mathias Olivera will be replaced by Leonardo Spinazzola (Napoli).
86' Napoli work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
84' A short pass finds Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.

79' 1 - 0 Goal! Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a low shot into the bottom right corner. Filip Stankovic is unable to keep the ball out of the net. It's 1:0.
79' Napoli have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
78' Matteo Politano (Napoli) takes the corner.
77' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Now Napoli have a corner.
75' Antonio Conte has decided to make a change. Matteo Politano (Napoli) replaces Khvicha Kvaratskhelia.
74' The yellow card is received by Filip Stankovic (Venezia).
71' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) meets a precise pass with a nice touch on the edge of the box and produces a shot to the middle of the goal. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper!
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Magnus Kofod Andersen (Venezia) comes onto the pitch so that Mikael Egill Ellertsson can be given a rest.
70' Antonio Conte has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) replacing Frank Anguissa.
70' Substitution. John Yeboah leaves the pitch and is replaced by Joel Pohjanpalo (Venezia).
69' David Neres (Napoli) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
68' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by David Neres (Napoli), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. Napoli force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
67' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
65' Filip Stankovic leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by David Neres (Napoli).

65' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) collects a pin-point pass inside the box and tries a snap shot in the vicinity of the right post, but the goalkeeper dives perfectly to deny him. The ball bounces off his gloves and brushes the post. That was a fantastic reflex save.
63' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) prepares to take a corner kick.

63' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity. The ball goes out for a corner. Venezia can continue in their attacking effort.
60' Here's the change. Franco Carboni leaves the pitch and Antonio Candela (Venezia) comes on as a substitute.

59' The ball is laid off to Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players low towards the middle of the goal and forces Filip Stankovic to make a decent save.
58' John Yeboah (Venezia) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
57' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
56' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Francesco Cosso blows his whistle for a foul.
56' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by John Yeboah (Venezia) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
53' Scott McTominay (Napoli) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
48' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
48' John Yeboah (Venezia) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
48' David Neres (Napoli) and Giovanni Di Lorenzo perform a quick tiki-taka to get past two defenders and then continue the move along the side line.
47' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Napoli.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+1' The match has reached half-time.
45' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) is penalised for a foul. Francesco Cosso had a clear view and blows his whistle.
43' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
40' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) collects a pass and strikes from about 7 metres out. It's a poor attempt which flies well over the bar.
40' Wow, what an escape. Scott McTominay (Napoli) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
39' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
38' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Alex Meret is alert and denies him.
37' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) sends the penalty to the bottom right corner, but Filip Stankovic pulls off a wonderful save to deny him.
37' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) is going to take the penalty!
36' Jay Idzes (Venezia) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. Penalty awarded! Napoli will take a penalty kick.
35' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
34' David Neres (Napoli) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. Napoli get a corner.
34' David Neres (Napoli) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

34' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. The ball goes out of play. Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
33' David Neres (Napoli) launches a cross from the corner, but Filip Stankovic is alert to thwart the effort.

33' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
32' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
31' Francesco Cosso shows a yellow card to Giorgio Altare (Venezia) for his blatant foul.
30' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) sends over a poor, overhit cross from the corner kick and the ball goes out of play.

30' Mathias Olivera (Napoli) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. The referee blows his whistle, Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
28' Scott McTominay (Napoli) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
26' David Neres (Napoli) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
22' Francesco Cosso blows his whistle after Franco Carboni (Venezia) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
20' The resulting corner from John Yeboah (Venezia) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
20' The resulting set piece from Venezia is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Venezia have been awarded a corner kick.
19' Alex Meret pulls off a great save to deny John Yeboah (Venezia), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner.
18' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Venezia, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
18' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Francesco Cosso has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
17' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) passes the ball onto Romelu Lukaku, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
15' The corner is swung in but Napoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

15' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) finds himself some space inside the box, collects a rebound and sends an effort in on goal. Filip Stankovic pulls off a fantastic reflex save to stop the ball going into the middle of the target. The ball is out of play. Napoli will have a chance to score from a corner.
14' David Neres (Napoli) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
13' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) sends a cross into the box, but Filip Stankovic comes off his line to gather the ball.
11' Napoli are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
10' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Venezia) picks up a pass and fires a powerful long-range shot which goes painfully close to the left post.
9' Gaetano Oristanio (Venezia) delivers a crossfield pass, but the ball is cut out before it reaches its intended target.
8' David Neres (Napoli) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.
7' Scott McTominay (Napoli) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Napoli will take a corner kick.
6' Jay Idzes (Venezia) commits a rough challenge and Francesco Cosso blows his whistle for a foul.
5' John Yeboah (Venezia) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
4' Napoli force their opponents to concede a corner.
4' Amir Rrahmani (Napoli) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and drills a shot to the middle of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Filip Stankovic.
3' David Neres (Napoli) works the corner short.

3' Napoli have been awarded a corner kick. Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
2' Frank Anguissa (Napoli) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
1' Romelu Lukaku (Napoli) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
1' Francesco Zampano (Venezia) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
1' The match has just started.
Venezia will kick-off.
Francesco Cosso is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
